voiceSettings.text: You lied about the clock to place Bram by the case. Your copper marker shorted your lamp and this room alone. You used Ada's wax to copy the lock's ward pattern; from that impression you cut the duplicate key, opened the case in the dark, and hid the ledger in your folio.
